query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_active, SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded, SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND street != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_real_street FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active';
